Alliance]] *[[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] }} '''Duro''' (also known as '''Duros''') was the heavily polluted and depopulated [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Located on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] itself was mostly abandoned, mainly housing food processing plants. Most of the population lived in one of the twenty [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] cities. Duro was also home to a large number of orbital [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. ==History== ===Pre-Republic=== [[File:Duro_NEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Duro prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]].]] Duro was surveyed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] in [[100,000 BBY/Legends|100,000 BBY]], but the Columi were not impressed and passed it off as a primitive failure, little knowing that the inhabitants of the world, the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], would become a [[Realspace/Legends|space-faring]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the years to come. Under the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], Duro was a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] world, and helped create the [[Star Forge]] [[30,000 BBY]]. Following a plague that struck the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]], the Duros rebelled in [[25,200 BBY]]. The Duros then formed a hereditary monarchy. It was based at [[Ranadaast]], a city named after [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Rana Mas Trehalt]], which fell into disrepair and was infested by criminals when the monarchy fell into decline. The monarchy declined due to the rise of corruption, and control by a merchant council. Several years after the fall of the monarchy, Duro became a member world of the [[Herglic Trade Empire]], the most powerful government in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region at the time. ===Old Republic=== Duros were interested in exploration and ventured off their homeworld to explore [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at an early age. [[Hyperspace cannon]]s linked Duro with [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and other [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Having reverse-engineered the [[Force-drive|Rakatan hyperdrive]] independently of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]], Duro entered a [[Golden Age (Duros)|Golden Age]] as a [[Core Founder/Legends|Core Founder]] [[25,053 BBY]] under Queen [[Rana Mas Trehalt]] at the formation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The monarchy was eventually abolished in favor of a collection of ruling corporations. The [[Duros High House]] became the government/legislature, and the [[Chief Representative Officer]] became the planet's head of state. At the same time, the [[Herglic Trade Empire]] fell with the formation of the new galactic government.
[[File:Durosurface.jpg|thumb|180px|The surface of Duro.]]
The Duros colonized [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] during their earliest wave of expansion, though the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] were considered a separate culture by [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]. The Duros discovered [[Sneeve/Legends|Sneeve]] in the [[Kymoodon Era]], [[Adner]] in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and [[Koboth]] (prior to [[219 BBY]]). The following years the Duros abandoned the planet for space cities, and left food production and mining on the planet to automated systems; however overdevelopment caused mass extinctions and pollution on the world. In [[3962 BBY]], the planet itself was laid to near-total waste during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] invasion fleet advancing on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] and [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] regions [[Battle of Duro (Mandalorian Wars)|destroyed]] much of the world using thousands of [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]]. Years of misery and rebuilding were ahead of the Duros people, merely the latest phase in the long series of [[Old Sith Wars]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the Duros colony on [[Harpori]] was [[Battle of Harpori|wiped out]] by [[Kaox Krul]] [[1002 BBY]]. ===Rise of the Empire=== Circa [[220 BBY/Legends|220 BBY]], during Duro's Industrial Age, the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] city of [[Tayana]] reached its height. In [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], the [[Tiercam Dam]] was built. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] launched [[Operation Durge's Lance]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a coordinated and major campaign that led to the [[Battle of Duro (Clone Wars)|capture]] of Duro. During the battle, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] ordered an [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the surface. This resulted in the pollutants from the numerous factories which covered Duro's surface to be released radioactively, and the surface being rendered the uninhabitable wasteland that it would remain until being [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongformed]] years later. The swift success of the campaign sent shockwaves throughout the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and even neutral [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] began to tighten its defenses. [[File:FefzeAttack.png|thumb|left|180px|[[Fefze beetle]]s attack [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Ken]].]] ===Galactic Empire=== The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] collected what was left of Duro's natural resources, and forced many Duros to move off the planet. In an attempt to stir up conflict between Duro and Corellia, the Empire declared Duro to be part of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. With the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] nationalized, the disgraced Neimoidians began to reintegrate themselves into mainstream Duros culture. At some point, Darth Vader's secret apprentice, Starkiller, was sent to Duro to dispose of a local despot who had grown too over-ambitious. While the precise details of the incident are unclear, All-Terrain Scout Transports were used against the darksider, earning his unending hatred of the walkers. The space city [[Pellezara station]], located near the planet in the Duro system, served as a maintenance stop over for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] en route to Duro.[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]] In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] tried to free the planet but they were defeated at the [[Battle of Vnas]]. ===New Republic=== As of [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the prisoner [[Triclops]] was being held on Duro, courtesy of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Bertroff Hissa]]. Triclops escaped and saved his son [[Ken]] from Hissa. Although the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] managed to save Duros archaeologists from the [[Valley of Royalty]], the Valley itself was flooded with toxic waste when the Tiercam Dam burst. The New Republic eventually liberated the planet, and put the system back in the Duro Sector. Ecosystem purification teams cleaned up the planet's atmosphere as best they could. [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], in [[Operation Shadow Hand]], Duro was [[Capture of Duro|retaken]] by the Empire, but eventually freed. [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], [[CorDuro Shipping]] took control of the [[Pri-Andylan shipyards]]. [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tresina Lobi]] and [[Thrynni Vae]] discovered CorDuro Shipping's ties to the [[Peace Brigade]], resulting in the Brigade murdering Thrynni. [[File:GatewayDomeDuro_njosb.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The Gateway Dome refugee camp on Duro in 26 ABY.]] ===Yuuzhan Vong Empire=== [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], the New Republic attempted to make Duro habitable and settle refugees there, though their efforts were sabotaged by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] agent [[Nom Anor]]. The Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Duro (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] Duro and destroyed nineteen of its twenty floating cities. During their occupation, they managed to reverse centuries of pollution in just two years with their biotechnology. It was later [[Raid on Duro|raided]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and [[Battle of the Duro system|again]] by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. ===Legacy era=== After the war's end, Duro returned to its lush forested past being restored by the Yuuzhan Vong [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]]. During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] had planned to conquer it to gain access to its [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]]. After the [[Battle of Caamas]] and the end of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], a Duros [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] named [[Gar Stazi]] led the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|remnants]] of the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] against the newly established [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]. Duro itself was subjugated by the Empire and was subject to a pervasive Imperial presence. An [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] was established in the planet; in it the most talented Duros taught Imperial pilots and capital ship crewmen.''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'' ==Fauna== Eventually, due to millennia of pollution, the only remaining creature on Duro was the nonnative [[Fefze beetle]], an aggressive mutation of the insectoid [[Fefze]], a species recruited to work on Duro during the last decades of the Galactic Republic. Extinct creatures included the [[cannibal arachnid]]s. When the Yuuzhan Vong arrived on Duro, they introduced many of their own creatures and creations onto the planet. ==Behind the scenes== The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars:
